name: Langfuse
description: Langfuse is an open-source LLM engineering platform. It records traces, token usage and costs from LLM applications and agents, and adds evaluations, prompt management and analytics dashboards.

app_vars.name: var_admin_email
app_vars.label: Admin Email
app_vars.help: Login for the generated admin account. Langfuse only uses it to send mail when SMTP is configured.

app_vars.name: var_admin_pass
app_vars.label: Admin Password
app_vars.help: Generated when left empty. At least 8 characters, without spaces, quotes or backslashes.

notes.text: The admin login and the Default project's API keys are saved to ~/langfuse.creds inside the container. Sign-up is off, invited users included; set AUTH_DISABLE_SIGNUP=false in /opt/langfuse_data/.env and restart langfuse-web while adding users.
Behind a reverse proxy, set NEXTAUTH_URL in /opt/langfuse_data/.env to the external URL and restart langfuse-web.
Media uploads and batch exports are not configured; they need an S3 endpoint reachable by clients.
